title: Concise Release Updates
summary: YTIntel release notifications are now intentionally short, silent and easy to scan in seconds.
discord_changes: Removed the @everyone ping completely so normal product updates stay useful without being intrusive.
Reduced each release card to one short summary, the three most important changes and a tiny live build receipt.
Made the release title itself open the live YTIntel build, removing extra sections and unnecessary links.
changes: Removed @everyone and disabled all Discord mentions for standard YTIntel release notifications.
Collapsed the old WHAT CHANGED, WHY IT MATTERS, RELEASE STATUS, MOMENTUM and BUILD RECEIPT blocks into one compact card.
Limited release highlights to the top three changes and shortened each line for fast scanning.
Kept a minimal footer showing live status, change count and short build SHA.
Kept release-burst protection so multi-file releases still produce only one final update card.
why_it_matters: A release notification should tell you what changed in a few seconds. Anything more becomes noise and makes important updates harder to notice.
